faqs.question: How do I create a free QR code?
faqs.answer: Choose your desired content type (Website URL, Plain Text, Wi-Fi, Email, Phone, or vCard), enter your information, customize colors and error correction if desired, and download your high-resolution QR code as a PNG, SVG, or JPG image instantly.

faqs.question: Do QR codes generated here ever expire?
faqs.answer: No. Our free QR code generator creates permanent static QR codes. The destination data is encoded directly into the pattern of black-and-white modules without any intermediary redirect server. They will continue to work indefinitely as long as your destination link or content remains active.

faqs.question: What is the difference between this tool, Adobe, and Canva QR code generators?
faqs.answer: While Adobe and Canva offer QR code generators, they typically require user accounts, email sign-ups, or paid subscriptions for high-resolution vector exports, and they embed QR codes inside design suites rather than providing quick standalone files. Our free QR code generator requires no account, provides lossless SVG vector downloads, includes a bulk QR code generator, and processes everything 100% locally in your browser with zero tracking.

faqs.question: Can I generate bulk QR codes at once?
faqs.answer: Yes. Switch to the 'Bulk QR Code Generator' tab, paste multiple URLs or text lines (one per line, or formatted as 'Label,Data'), and our tool will generate all QR codes simultaneously with individual PNG/SVG downloads and a batch download option.

faqs.question: How do I create a Wi-Fi QR code that connects automatically?
faqs.answer: Select the 'Wi-Fi Network' tab, enter your network name (SSID), password, and security type (WPA/WPA2/WEP). When scanned with a smartphone camera, the device automatically prompts the user to join the Wi-Fi network without manually typing passwords.

faqs.question: Which download format should I choose: PNG, SVG, or JPG?
faqs.answer: For web pages, social media, and digital screens, choose high-resolution PNG (512px or 1024px). For professional printing, signage, brochures, and commercial merchandise, choose SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics) because it scales to any dimension without pixelation or blurriness.

faqs.question: Can I add a custom logo or image in the center of my QR code?
faqs.answer: Yes. In the design options, you can choose a preset icon (Link, Wi-Fi, Mail, Star) or upload your own company logo. When adding a center logo, we automatically increase error correction to High (Q or H) so the QR code remains 100% readable by all mobile scanners.

faqs.question: Are my QR codes and input data saved on any server?
faqs.answer: No. All QR code generation takes place 100% client-side inside your browser using JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas. No URLs, Wi-Fi passwords, contact details, or generated images are ever uploaded to or stored on our servers.

faqs.question: Do these QR codes expire or have scan limits?
faqs.answer: No. These are standard static QR codes where data is encoded directly into the pixel pattern. They never expire and have zero scan limits.

faqs.question: Which error correction level should I choose?
faqs.answer: For digital screens, Level M (15%) is standard. For outdoor posters, packaging, or if you plan to overlay a central logo, select Level H (30%) to allow reconstruction of occluded modules.

faqs.question: What is the "quiet zone" around the QR code?
faqs.answer: The quiet zone is the blank margin surrounding the barcode (minimum 4 module widths). It is mandatory so smartphone camera sensors can isolate the matrix from surrounding design elements.

faqs.question: Does generating QR codes send my data or Wi-Fi passwords to a server?
faqs.answer: No. The matrix calculation runs 100% locally in your browser memory. Sensitive Wi-Fi passwords and private URLs never leave your machine.

en.contentHtml:
Free QR Code Generator for Custom & Dynamic Needs

A QR Code Generator is an essential online utility that translates textual and binary data into a two-dimensional matrix barcode composed of high-contrast modules. Designed originally by Denso Wave in 1994, Quick Response (QR) codes have become the global standard for bridging offline printed media with digital destinations.

While many commercial generators lock your data behind expiring redirection links or charge steep monthly subscriptions, our free QR code generator creates 100% static, un-throttled codes. Whether you are creating a simple link for your personal portfolio, encoding sensitive office Wi-Fi credentials, or running an inventory campaign with our bulk QR code generator, the code is rendered directly on your device with complete privacy.

♾️

Never Expiring

Static QR codes encode data permanently into the module pattern. They will never stop working or redirect to third-party ads.

🔒

Zero Server Tracking

Entirely client-side execution. Your URLs, contact cards, and Wi-Fi network passwords remain confidential on your device.

📐

Print-Ready Vector SVG

Download lossless SVG files for billposters, restaurant menus, packaging, and magazines without any pixel blurriness.

How to Generate a QR Code for Free

Generating a professional QR code takes just a few seconds. Follow this straightforward step-by-step workflow:

Step 1

Pick Content Type

Select what information you want your QR code to trigger: a website URL, plain message, Wi-Fi login, email, phone call, or digital business card (vCard).

Step 2

Enter Your Data

Type or paste your destination link or credentials. The tool formats standard protocol headers automatically (e.g., https:// or WIFI:).

Step 3

Customize Appearance

Pick your brand colors, toggle transparent backgrounds, adjust the quiet zone margin, and select square or rounded dot corner styles.

Step 4

Add Center Logo (Optional)

Upload your company badge or select an embedded icon (Link, Wi-Fi, Mail). The error correction level automatically adapts for readability.

Step 5

Test Scan

Point your smartphone camera at the live preview box to verify that the destination opens swiftly before sending to production.

Step 6

Download High-Res

Save your QR code as a PNG image for screen use, an SVG vector file for physical print, or copy directly to your clipboard.

Bulk QR Code Generator: Create Hundreds of Codes in Seconds

Marketing teams, event organizers, and warehouse logistics managers frequently need to produce large quantities of barcodes simultaneously. Rather than creating each graphic individually, our bulk QR code generator allows you to batch-process dozens or hundreds of entries in a single step.

Simply paste a list of URLs or text strings into the batch input area—one line per entry. You can even specify custom card labels using simple comma separation (such as Table 1,https://menu.com/1). Because the batch engine runs purely on your computer's local processor, it avoids server rate limits, operates at lightning speed, and enables sequential one-click downloads.

Top Use Cases for Bulk QR Code Generation:

  • ✓ Restaurant Menus: Individual QR codes mapped to specific table numbers for contactless ordering.
  • ✓ Event Ticketing: Unique check-in URLs or attendee registration IDs printed on badges.
  • ✓ Product Inventory: SKU labels and warehouse bin location tracking tags.
  • ✓ Direct Mail Marketing: Personalized PURL links printed across catalog runs.

QR Code Generator vs Adobe & Canva: Which Should You Use?

Popular creative suites such as the Adobe QR code generator (part of Adobe Express) and the Canva QR code generator provide built-in barcode tools. While both are convenient when you are already designing a flyer inside their respective platforms, they come with substantial limitations for standalone and technical workflows:

Feature Our Free QR Generator Adobe QR Code Generator Canva QR Code Generator
Account Required None (Instant) Adobe Account / Login Canva Account / Login
Vector SVG Export Included Free Requires Creative Cloud / Subscription Embedded in canvas design
Bulk QR Code Generator Built-In (No Limits) Not Available Requires Canva Pro App Applet
Data Privacy 100% Client-Side Local Stored on Adobe Servers Stored on Canva Cloud
Expiration & Watermarks Permanent (Zero Marks) Permanent Static Permanent Static

If you simply want a clean, print-ready, high-resolution barcode without signing into an enterprise software account or getting funneled into subscription plans, our standalone generator is designed for immediate productivity.

Static vs Dynamic QR Codes: Do Free QR Codes Expire?

A common frustration among online users is printing thousands of flyers only to find out months later that their QR code suddenly stopped working, showing a "Subscription Expired" notice. It is important to understand the fundamental technical difference between static and dynamic codes:

✓ Static QR Codes (What This Tool Creates)

In a static QR code, the full alphanumeric destination (such as https://yourdomain.com or your Wi-Fi password) is directly mathematically encoded into the geometric pixel grid.

  • Zero expiration risk: Works forever.
  • Zero dependencies: Scanners decode the data directly with no server middleman.
  • True privacy: Nobody can intercept or monitor your visitor traffic.

⚠️ Dynamic QR Codes (Subscription Redirection)

Dynamic QR codes encode a short redirect link owned by a commercial service (e.g., qr.co/abc123). When scanned, the provider looks up your real URL and forwards the visitor.

  • Recurring cost: If you stop paying their monthly subscription, the link breaks.
  • Redirect latency: Adds an unnecessary network hop before landing on your page.
  • Single point of failure: If the provider shuts down, your print runs are ruined.

Best Practices for Printing and Scanning QR Codes

To ensure your printed QR codes can be read quickly and reliably across all smartphone models and lighting conditions, adhere to the following professional design principles:

1. Maintain Strong Color Contrast

Optical sensors detect light reflection. Always ensure the foreground barcode modules are significantly darker than the background. Dark charcoal, deep navy, or classic black on a crisp white or light ivory background provides maximum scanning speed.

2. Respect the Quiet Zone Margin

The white border framing the QR code is technically called the "Quiet Zone." It isolates the matrix from surrounding text and imagery. Maintain at least 2 to 4 modules of margin on all four sides so camera firmware can locate the three corner position squares.

3. Minimum Physical Print Sizing

For business cards and tabletop cards scanned within arm's reach (0.5m), print the code at least 2 cm × 2 cm (0.8 × 0.8 inches). For window decals, posters, or exhibition stands viewed from 2 meters away, increase dimensions to at least 20 cm × 20 cm.

4. Select High Error Correction for Logos

Reed-Solomon error correction allows cameras to reconstruct missing or obstructed data. If placing a logo in the center or printing on items susceptible to scratching (stickers, outdoor signage), always choose Level Q (25%) or H (30%).

faqs.question: मुफ्त QR कोड कैसे बनाएं?
faqs.answer: वेबसाइट URL, सामान्य टेक्स्ट, वाई-फाई, ईमेल या संपर्क विवरण चुनें, जानकारी दर्ज करें और PNG या SVG फॉर्मेट में तुरंत डाउनलोड करें।

faqs.question: क्या यहाँ बनाए गए QR कोड कभी एक्सपायर होते हैं?
faqs.answer: नहीं। यह टूल स्थायी स्टेटिक QR कोड बनाता है। इसमें कोई एक्सपायरी डेट नहीं होती और यह आजीवन सक्रिय रहता है।

faqs.question: यह एडोब और कैनवा से कैसे अलग है?
faqs.answer: यहाँ बिना किसी अकाउंट, सब्सक्रिप्शन या विज्ञापन के सीधे हाई-रेजोल्यूशन वेक्टर SVG और बल्क QR कोड मुफ्त में मिलते हैं।

faqs.question: क्या एक साथ कई (Bulk) QR कोड बना सकते हैं?
faqs.answer: हाँ। 'Bulk QR Code Generator' टैब में एक साथ कई लिंक या टेक्स्ट पेस्ट करें और एक क्लिक में सभी QR कोड तैयार करें।

faqs.question: वाई-फाई QR कोड कैसे काम करता है?
faqs.answer: वाई-फाई का नाम और पासवर्ड दर्ज करें। जब कोई इसे स्मार्टफोन से स्कैन करेगा, तो बिना पासवर्ड टाइप किए फोन सीधे वाई-फाई से कनेक्ट हो जाएगा।

faqs.question: PNG, SVG या JPG में से कौन सा फॉर्मेट चुनें?
faqs.answer: स्क्रीन व सोशल मीडिया के लिए PNG तथा प्रिंटिंग, बैनर और पोस्टर के लिए SVG (वेक्टर) फॉर्मेट सबसे अच्छा रहता है।

faqs.question: क्या QR कोड के बीच में अपना लोगो जोड़ सकते हैं?
faqs.answer: हाँ। आप अपनी कंपनी का लोगो या कोई भी आइकन बीच में जोड़ सकते हैं।

faqs.question: क्या मेरा डेटा किसी सर्वर पर सुरक्षित होता है?
faqs.answer: नहीं, सारी प्रोसेसिंग 100% आपके ब्राउज़र में होती है और कोई डेटा सर्वर पर स्टोर नहीं किया जाता।

faqs.question: क्या ये QR कोड कभी एक्सपायर होते हैं या स्कैन की कोई सीमा है?
faqs.answer: नहीं। ये मानक स्टेटिक QR कोड हैं जिनमें डेटा सीधे पिक्सेल पैटर्न में इनकोड होता है। ये कभी समाप्त नहीं होते और इन्हें असीमित बार स्कैन किया जा सकता है।

faqs.question: मुझे कौन सा त्रुटि सुधार स्तर (Error Correction) चुनना चाहिए?
faqs.answer: डिजिटल स्क्रीन के लिए स्तर M (15%) उपयुक्त है। यदि आप पोस्टर पर प्रिंट कर रहे हैं या बीच में लोगो लगाना चाहते हैं तो स्तर H (30%) चुनें।

faqs.question: QR कोड के चारों ओर "क्वाइट ज़ोन" (Quiet Zone) क्या होता है?
faqs.answer: यह QR कोड के चारों ओर का खाली बॉर्डर (कम से कम 4 मॉड्यूल चौड़ा) होता है, जिससे स्मार्टफोन कैमरा कोड को आसानी से पहचान सके।

faqs.question: क्या QR कोड बनाते समय मेरा डेटा या वाई-फाई पासवर्ड सर्वर पर जाता है?
faqs.answer: बिल्कुल नहीं। संपूर्ण मैट्रिक्स गणना आपके ब्राउज़र में होती है। कोई भी डेटा बाहरी सर्वर पर नहीं भेजा जाता।

stepByStep.instruction: Elija entre Bajo (7%), Medio (15%), Cuartil (25%) o Alto (30% ideal si incluye logotipos).

stepByStep.title: Ajustar tamaño y colores
stepByStep.instruction: Configure la resolución y contraste entre módulos y fondo para asegurar escaneo rápido.

stepByStep.title: Descargar código QR
stepByStep.instruction: Guarde el archivo como PNG de alta definición o SVG vectorial listo para imprimir.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo creo un código QR gratis?
faqs.answer: Elige el tipo de contenido (URL web, texto, Wi-Fi, email, teléfono o vCard), introduce los datos, personaliza colores y descarga tu código QR en PNG o SVG al instante.

faqs.question: ¿Caducan los códigos QR generados aquí?
faqs.answer: No. Nuestro generador crea códigos QR estáticos permanentes. La información se codifica directamente en los módulos sin intermediarios ni caducidad.

faqs.question: ¿Qué diferencia hay con los generadores de Adobe o Canva?
faqs.answer: A diferencia de Adobe o Canva, no requerimos suscripciones ni cuentas de usuario. Ofrecemos exportación SVG vectorial y generador por lotes de forma gratuita y 100% privada.

faqs.question: ¿Puedo generar múltiples códigos QR en bloque (bulk)?
faqs.answer: Sí. Accede a la pestaña 'Bulk QR Code Generator', pega tu lista de enlaces y genera decenas de códigos QR de una sola vez.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo crear un código QR para conexión Wi-Fi automática?
faqs.answer: Selecciona 'Red Wi-Fi', introduce nombre de red (SSID), contraseña y tipo de cifrado. Al escanearlo, el móvil se conectará sin teclear contraseñas.

faqs.question: ¿Qué formato descargar: PNG, SVG o JPG?
faqs.answer: PNG para pantallas y redes sociales; SVG vectorial para impresiones profesionales, carteles y papelería sin pixelación.

faqs.question: ¿Puedo añadir un logotipo en el centro del código QR?
faqs.answer: Sí. Sube tu logotipo o elige iconos predefinidos. El nivel de corrección de errores se ajusta automáticamente para garantizar su legibilidad.

faqs.question: ¿Se guardan mis datos o códigos en algún servidor?
faqs.answer: No. Todo el proceso de generación ocurre de manera 100% local en tu navegador con total privacidad.

faqs.question: ¿Caducan estos códigos QR o tienen límite de lecturas?
faqs.answer: No. Son códigos estáticos estándar con los datos incrustados en los módulos. Funcionan de forma permanente y sin cuotas.

faqs.question: ¿Qué nivel de corrección de error conviene elegir?
faqs.answer: Para pantallas suele bastar el nivel M (15%). Para impresión en papel o si se añade un logo, elija el nivel H (30%).

faqs.question: ¿Qué es la "zona muda" (quiet zone)?
faqs.answer: Es el margen en blanco que rodea al código (mínimo 4 módulos de ancho) necesario para que las cámaras distingan el código del fondo.

faqs.question: ¿Se envía información a servidores al generar el código?
faqs.answer: No. La matriz se dibuja totalmente en la memoria del navegador. Claves y enlaces se procesan en privado.

stepByStep.instruction: ワンクリックで高解像度PNGまたはベクターSVG形式で保存し、印刷物やWebサイトに配置します。

faqs.question: QRコードジェネレーターとは何ですか？
faqs.answer: WebサイトのURLやテキスト、Wi-Fi接続情報などをスマートフォンで読み取り可能な二次元バーコードに変換するツールです。

faqs.question: 作成したQRコードに有効期限はありますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ。当ツールで生成されるQRコードは恒久的な「静的QRコード」であり、有効期限はなく永久に使用可能です。

faqs.question: AdobeやCanvaのQRコード作成との違いは何ですか？
faqs.answer: ユーザー登録や有料課金が不要で、高品質なベクターSVG出力や一括生成（バルク生成）を完全無料で利用できます。

faqs.question: 一度に大量のQRコードを一括作成できますか？
faqs.answer: はい。「一括生成」タブから複数のURLを貼り付けるだけで、まとめて生成・ダウンロードが可能です。

faqs.question: Wi-Fi接続用QRコードの作成方法は？
faqs.answer: Wi-Fiタブを選択し、SSID（ネットワーク名）とパスワードを入力するだけで、スキャン時に自動接続するコードが作れます。

faqs.question: PNG形式とSVG形式のどちらを選ぶべきですか？
faqs.answer: Webサイトや画面表示にはPNG、チラシ・看板・名刺などの印刷用途には拡大しても劣化しないSVGが最適です。

faqs.question: QRコードの中央にロゴマークを配置できますか？
faqs.answer: はい。ロゴ画像をアップロード可能で、誤り訂正レベルを自動調整して確実な読み取りを維持します。

faqs.question: 入力したURLやパスワードはサーバーに送信されますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ。すべての処理はお客様の端末（ブラウザ）内で完結するため、安全かつプライバシーが保たれます。

faqs.question: 作成したQRコードに有効期限やスキャン回数の制限はありますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ。URLや文字列が直接モジュールとして埋め込まれる静的（スタティック）QRコードのため、期限切れやスキャン制限はありません。

faqs.question: 誤り訂正レベルはどれを選べば良いですか？
faqs.answer: Webや画面表示なら標準のM（15%）、チラシや屋外看板への印刷、中央にロゴを配置したい場合は最高耐久のH（30%）をおすすめします。

faqs.question: QRコード周辺の「余白（クワイエットゾーン）」とは何ですか？
faqs.answer: QRコードの周囲に必要な白枠のことで、最低でもモジュール幅4個分の空白が必要です。これが不足するとカメラの認識率が低下します。

faqs.question: Wi-Fiパスワードや個人情報が外部サーバーに送信されますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ。すべての描画計算はお使いのブラウザ内部で行われます。ネットワークを介したデータ送信は一切ありません。

faqs.question: Comment créer un code QR gratuitement ?
faqs.answer: Choisissez le type de contenu (URL, texte, Wi-Fi, email, téléphone ou vCard), saisissez vos informations, personnalisez le style et téléchargez votre QR code en PNG ou SVG.

faqs.question: Les QR codes générés expirent-ils un jour ?
faqs.answer: Non. Ce sont des QR codes statiques permanents. Les données sont directement inscrites dans la matrice sans redirection serveur intermédiaire.

faqs.question: Quelle est la différence avec Adobe et Canva ?
faqs.answer: Aucun compte ni abonnement requis, téléchargement vectoriel SVG gratuit, générateur par lot inclus et exécution 100% locale sans pistage.

faqs.question: Puis-je générer des codes QR en masse (bulk) ?
faqs.answer: Oui, collez votre liste d'URLs ou de textes dans l'onglet 'Générateur par lot' pour créer plusieurs dizaines de codes en un clic.

faqs.question: Comment créer un QR code Wi-Fi à connexion directe ?
faqs.answer: Indiquez le nom du réseau (SSID) et le mot de passe dans l'onglet Wi-Fi pour permettre une connexion automatique au scan.

faqs.question: Quel format de téléchargement privilégier ?
faqs.answer: PNG pour un affichage sur écrans web et réseaux sociaux ; SVG vectoriel pour l'impression haute définition sur tous supports.

faqs.question: Puis-je intégrer mon logo au centre du code QR ?
faqs.answer: Oui, importez votre logo d'entreprise. La correction d'erreur s'adapte automatiquement pour maintenir un scan optimal.

faqs.question: Mes données sont-elles conservées sur un serveur ?
faqs.answer: Non, toute la génération s'exécute localement dans votre navigateur sans aucune transmission de données.

faqs.question: Ces QR codes expirent-ils ou ont-ils une limite de scans ?
faqs.answer: Non. Il s'agit de QR codes statiques. Les données sont inscrites directement dans le motif et restent valides indéfiniment sans restriction.

faqs.question: Quel niveau de correction d'erreur choisir ?
faqs.answer: Le niveau M (15%) convient pour les écrans. Pour l'impression papier ou si vous collez un logo au centre, choisissez le niveau H (30%).

faqs.question: Qu'est-ce que la zone de silence (quiet zone) ?
faqs.answer: C'est la marge blanche autour du code (au moins 4 modules de largeur) indispensable pour permettre à l'appareil photo de le détecter.

faqs.question: Mes données ou mots de passe Wi-Fi sont-ils transmis à un serveur ?
faqs.answer: Non. La synthèse matricielle est réalisée à 100 % dans votre navigateur en toute confidentialité.

faqs.question: Wie erstelle ich einen kostenlosen QR-Code?
faqs.answer: Wählen Sie den gewünschten Inhaltstyp (Webseite, Text, WLAN, E-Mail, Telefon oder vCard), geben Sie die Daten ein und laden Sie den QR-Code als PNG oder SVG herunter.

faqs.question: Laufen die hier generierten QR-Codes jemals ab?
faqs.answer: Nein. Wir erstellen permanente, statische QR-Codes. Die Zielinformationen sind direkt codiert und bleiben dauerhaft und uneingeschränkt funktionsfähig.

faqs.question: Was unterscheidet dieses Tool von Adobe und Canva?
faqs.answer: Keine Anmeldung, keine Kosten, kostenloser SVG-Vektorexport, integrierter Stapelgenerator und 100% Datenschutz ohne Server-Tracking.

faqs.question: Kann ich mehrere QR-Codes gleichzeitig (Bulk) erstellen?
faqs.answer: Ja, im Tab 'Massen-QR-Code-Generator' können Sie Listen von Webseiten einfügen und stapelweise verarbeiten.

faqs.question: Wie erstelle ich einen automatischen WLAN-QR-Code?
faqs.answer: Geben Sie Netzwerkname (SSID) und Passwort ein. Beim Scannen mit dem Smartphone wird die Verbindung direkt hergestellt.

faqs.question: Welches Format sollte gewählt werden: PNG oder SVG?
faqs.answer: PNG eignet sich ideal für Bildschirme und Präsentationen, SVG für gestochen scharfen Druck in beliebiger Größe.

faqs.question: Kann ich ein Firmenlogo in der Mitte platzieren?
faqs.answer: Ja, laden Sie Ihr Logo hoch. Die Fehlerkorrektur wird automatisch erhöht, um die Lesbarkeit sicherzustellen.

faqs.question: Werden meine Daten auf einem Server gespeichert?
faqs.answer: Nein. Die Erstellung läuft zu 100% lokal in Ihrem Browser ab. Keine Daten verlassen Ihr Gerät.

faqs.question: Laufen diese QR-Codes ab oder gibt es Scan-Limits?
faqs.answer: Nein. Es handelt sich um statische QR-Codes, bei denen die Information direkt im Pixelmuster gespeichert ist. Sie bleiben dauerhaft gültig.

faqs.question: Welches Fehlerkorrektur-Level sollte gewählt werden?
faqs.answer: Level M (15 %) reicht für Bildschirme. Für gedruckte Flyer oder Plakate mit Logo-Überlagerung empfiehlt sich Level H (30 %).

faqs.question: Was bedeutet die "Ruhezone" um den QR-Code?
faqs.answer: Der unbedruckte Randbereich (mindestens 4 Modulbreiten), den Smartphone-Kameras zwingend benötigen, um den Barcode vom Hintergrund zu trennen.

faqs.question: Werden WLAN-Passwörter oder Daten an Server übertragen?
faqs.answer: Nein. Die Erstellung läuft zu 100 % lokal im Arbeitsspeicher Ihres Browsers ab.

faqs.question: Como criar um código QR grátis?
faqs.answer: Escolha o tipo de dado (URL, texto, Wi-Fi, e-mail, telefone ou vCard), preencha as informações e baixe seu código QR em PNG ou SVG na hora.

faqs.question: Os códigos QR gerados têm data de expiração?
faqs.answer: Não. Nosso gerador produz códigos QR estáticos definitivos sem redirecionamentos e que nunca expiram.

faqs.question: Qual a diferença em relação ao Adobe ou Canva?
faqs.answer: Sem exigência de login, sem assinaturas pagas, exportação vetorial SVG gratuita e geração em lote com total privacidade.

faqs.question: É possível gerar códigos QR em massa (bulk)?
faqs.answer: Sim. Cole sua lista de links no modo em lote e processe dezenas de códigos simultaneamente.

faqs.question: Como gerar um QR code para Wi-Fi automático?
faqs.answer: Digite o nome da rede (SSID) e a senha na aba Wi-Fi para que as pessoas se conectem sem precisar digitar a senha.

faqs.question: Qual formato baixar: PNG, SVG ou JPG?
faqs.answer: PNG para redes sociais e websites; SVG vetorial para impressão profissional sem perda de qualidade.

faqs.question: Posso incluir logotipo da minha marca no centro?
faqs.answer: Sim. Faça upload da imagem e o sistema ajustará a correção de erros para garantir leitura perfeita.

faqs.question: Os meus dados ficam salvos em algum servidor?
faqs.answer: Não. Toda a renderização acontece no navegador de forma 100% segura e privada.

faqs.question: Esses códigos QR expiram ou possuem limite de leitura?
faqs.answer: Não. São QR codes estáticos em que a informação fica gravada no padrão de módulos. Funcionam para sempre e sem limites.

faqs.question: Qual nível de correção de erro devo escolher?
faqs.answer: Para telas e sites, o nível M (15%) é ideal. Para impressos ou códigos com logotipo no centro, use o nível H (30%).

faqs.question: O que é a "zona de silêncio" (margem)?
faqs.answer: É a borda em branco ao redor do código (mínimo de 4 módulos) necessária para a câmera do celular focar e ler a matriz.

faqs.question: Meus dados ou senhas de Wi-Fi são enviados a algum servidor?
faqs.answer: Não. Todo o cálculo ocorre no seu próprio navegador via JavaScript local, garantindo total privacidade.

ko.description: 웹사이트 URL, 텍스트, 와이파이, 연락처를 위한 맞춤형 QR 코드를 만드세요.
ko.shortDescription: 웹사이트 URL, 텍스트, 와이파이, 연락처를 위한 맞춤형 QR 코드를 만드세요.
ko.intro: 웹사이트 URL, 텍스트, 와이파이, 연락처를 위한 맞춤형 QR 코드를 만드세요.
ko.formulaTitle: ISO/IEC 18004 표준 리드-솔로몬 오류 정정 및 2D 매트릭스 렌더링 구조
ko.formulaDescription: QR 코드 생성기는 ISO/IEC 18004 표준에 따라 갈루아 체 연산과 리드-솔로몬(Reed-Solomon) 다항식 오류 정정(L: 7%, M: 15%, Q: 25%, H: 30%)을 적용하여 2D 매트릭스 그리드를 생성하며, 원격 서버 호출 없이 브라우저 HTML5 Canvas에서 고해상도 PNG 또는 SVG로 즉시 렌더링합니다.

stepByStep.title: 텍스트 또는 URL 입력
stepByStep.instruction: QR 코드로 변환할 웹사이트 주소, 와이파이 접속 정보, 연락처 또는 일반 텍스트를 입력합니다.

stepByStep.title: 오류 복원율 선택
stepByStep.instruction: 용도에 따라 Low(7%), Medium(15%), Quartile(25%), High(30%・로고 삽입 및 인쇄물용) 중 선택합니다.

stepByStep.title: 크기 및 색상 맞춤 설정
stepByStep.instruction: 스마트폰 카메라 인식률을 높이기 위해 충분한 대비의 배경색과 모듈 크기, 여백을 조절합니다.

stepByStep.title: QR 코드 다운로드
stepByStep.instruction: 고해상도 PNG 또는 크기 조절이 자유로운 벡터 SVG 파일로 즉시 저장합니다.

faqs.question: 무료로 QR 코드를 생성하는 방법은?
faqs.answer: 웹사이트 URL, 텍스트, Wi-Fi, 이메일, 명함 등 원하는 유형을 선택하고 정보를 입력한 뒤 고해상도 PNG 또는 SVG로 즉시 다운로드하세요.

faqs.question: 생성된 QR 코드에 유효기간이 있나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 본 도구는 영구적인 정적 QR 코드를 생성하므로 시간이 지나도 만료되지 않고 평생 작동합니다.

faqs.question: Adobe나 Canva QR 코드 도구와의 차이점은?
faqs.answer: 회원가입이나 유료 결제 없이 인쇄용 벡터 SVG 무료 다운로드, 대량 생성 기능을 완전히 무료로 제공합니다.

faqs.question: 한 번에 여러 개의 QR 코드를 대량(Bulk) 생성할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네. 대량 생성 탭에서 링크 목록을 입력하면 수십 개의 QR 코드를 한 번에 생성하고 저장할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 스캔 시 자동 연결되는 Wi-Fi QR 코드는 어떻게 만드나요?
faqs.answer: 네트워크 이름(SSID)과 비밀번호를 입력하면 스마트폰 카메라로 스캔 시 비밀번호 입력 없이 즉시 연결됩니다.

faqs.question: PNG와 SVG 중 어떤 파일 형식으로 저장해야 하나요?
faqs.answer: 모바일 화면과 웹 게시용은 PNG, 현수막, 전단지, 명함 등 고품질 인쇄용은 무손실 벡터 SVG를 권장합니다.

faqs.question: QR 코드 중앙에 브랜드 로고를 넣을 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네. 회사 로고나 맞춤 아이콘을 중앙에 삽입할 수 있으며 오류 복원율을 자동으로 높여 인식률을 유지합니다.

faqs.question: 입력한 개인정보나 Wi-Fi 암호가 서버에 저장되나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 모든 생성 작업은 브라우저 내부에서만 처리되며 어떠한 데이터도 외부 서버로 전송되지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 생성된 QR 코드에 유효기간이나 스캔 횟수 제한이 있나요?
faqs.answer: 전혀 없습니다. 데이터가 흑백 모듈 패턴 자체에 직접 영구 기록되는 정적(Static) QR 코드이므로 평생 무료로 무제한 스캔할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 오류 복원 등급(Error Correction)은 무엇을 선택해야 하나요?
faqs.answer: 일반 모바일 화면 공유는 M 레벨(15%), 종이 인쇄물이나 중앙에 브랜드 로고를 덧붙일 경우에는 H 레벨(30%) 선택을 권장합니다.

faqs.question: QR 코드 주변의 여백(Quiet Zone)은 왜 필요한가요?
faqs.answer: 스마트폰 카메라가 주변 이미지와 바코드를 혼동하지 않고 정확히 인식하기 위한 필수 공백 영역(최소 4모듈 이상 폭)입니다.

faqs.question: 와이파이 비밀번호 등 개인 데이터가 서버로 전송되나요?
faqs.answer: 아닙니다. 모든 2D 바코드 매트릭스 연산은 기기 브라우저 메모리 내에서 100% 로컬로 실행되므로 외부 유출이 없습니다.

stepByStep.title: Inserire testo o URL
stepByStep.instruction: Digita il link, le credenziali Wi-Fi o le informazioni da codificare nel QR code.

stepByStep.title: Scegliere la correzione errori

stepByStep.title: Regolare dimensioni e colori
stepByStep.instruction: Imposta la risoluzione garantendo un contrasto cromatico netto per la scansione.

stepByStep.title: Scaricare il codice
stepByStep.instruction: Scarica il QR code in formato PNG ad alta definizione o SVG vettoriale.

faqs.question: Come creare un codice QR gratis?
faqs.answer: Seleziona la tipologia di contenuto (URL web, testo, Wi-Fi, email, telefono o vCard), inserisci i dati e scarica il file PNG o SVG all'istante.

faqs.question: I codici QR generati hanno una scadenza?
faqs.answer: No. Generiamo codici QR statici permanenti che non scadono mai e non dipendono da server intermediari.

faqs.question: In cosa differisce da Adobe e Canva?
faqs.answer: Nessun account obbligatorio, nessun piano a pagamento, esportazione vettoriale SVG inclusa e massima privacy locale.

faqs.question: Posso generare codici QR in blocco (bulk)?
faqs.answer: Sì, incolla un elenco di indirizzi nella scheda per la generazione massiva e scaricali tutti insieme.

faqs.question: Come creare un codice QR per il collegamento Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Inserisci SSID e password nella scheda dedicata per consentire l'accesso immediato con la fotocamera.

faqs.question: Quale formato di download conviene scegliere?
faqs.answer: PNG per siti e canali digitali; SVG per cartellonistica, volantini e stampe tipografiche ad alta definizione.

faqs.question: È possibile aggiungere un logo al centro?
faqs.answer: Sì, caricando un logo aziendale la correzione degli errori viene potenziata automaticamente per preservare la scansione.

faqs.question: I miei dati vengono registrati da qualche parte?
faqs.answer: No. Tutto viene elaborato in locale nel tuo browser per garantire la massima riservatezza.

faqs.question: I codici QR hanno una data di scadenza o limiti di scansione?
faqs.answer: No. Sono codici statici permanenti in cui il contenuto è incorporato nei pixel. Non scadono mai e non hanno limiti di utilizzo.

faqs.question: Quale livello di correzione errori conviene impostare?
faqs.answer: Livello M (15%) per l'uso a video. Livello H (30%) per stampe su carta, manifesti o se intendi applicare un logo al centro.

faqs.question: Cosa si intende per "zona di rispetto" (quiet zone)?
faqs.answer: È il margine bianco perimetrale (almeno 4 moduli) che consente alla fotocamera dello smartphone di isolare e decodificare il codice.

faqs.question: Le informazioni o le password Wi-Fi vengono trasmesse a server remoti?
faqs.answer: No. La generazione della matrice avviene esclusivamente in locale nel browser, senza alcun passaggio su server.
